svg.title: Gaussian noise distributions of two neighboring PAM-4 levels
svg.desc: Two Gaussian probability densities centered at the levels mu k and mu k+1, a dashed threshold theta k halfway between them (distance d/2 to each level), and the shaded tails beyond the threshold: the probability of a symbol error, Q((theta - mu)/sigma).
